Use it from an AI agent

Install the Better SFX skill in Claude Code, Codex or any agent that supports skills. Your agent can then search the library, download the right sounds into your project and wire them up.

Install the skill
npx skills add devhims/better-sfx

Agents without the skill can read catalog.json or llms.txt. Every sound has a stable file URL. The skill, the sound recipes and the site are all on GitHub.

Free for any project

  • No account, no credit required, no fees per use.
  • Do not resell or redistribute the sounds on their own, or register them with Content ID.
Read the license

Questions

What Better SFX is, what you can do with the sounds, and how agents use them.

What is Better SFX?

Better SFX is a free library of 161 short sound effects for apps, websites, videos and AI agents, made by video2ctx. It covers clicks, toggles, notifications, success and error cues, whooshes and transitions, keyboard and paper foley, and five matching UI sound sets.

Is Better SFX free?

Yes. Every sound is free for personal and commercial use, with no account and no credit required. The one rule is that you cannot resell or redistribute the sounds on their own. The full terms are in the Better SFX License.

Can I use these sound effects in videos?

Yes. You can use them in YouTube videos, Reels, TikToks, tutorials, screen recordings, product demos, ads and films, including monetized videos. Nobody is allowed to register the sounds with YouTube Content ID.

How were the sounds made?

121 sounds are made in code with the Web Audio API. 40 are recordings generated with Seed Audio 1.0 and then trimmed, cleaned of silent gaps and matched in loudness.

What are the matching sound sets?

Glass, wood, soft, retro 8-bit and mechanical. Each set covers the same ten app actions: click, hover, toggle, notify, success, error, open, close, send and delete, so one app can use a single set that sounds consistent.

Which file formats are available?

Every sound is a 48 kHz, 16-bit mono WAV and a 128 kbps M4A, at a stable URL such as /sounds/glass-click.wav.

Can an AI agent find and use these sounds?

Yes. Install the Better SFX agent skill with "npx skills add devhims/better-sfx" in Claude Code, Codex or any agent that supports skills. It lets your agent search the library, download the right sounds into your project and wire them up. Agents can also read https://sfx.video2ctx.dev/catalog.json and https://sfx.video2ctx.dev/llms.txt directly.
